pages.title: Your Salesmsg onboarding
pages.subtitle: Five stages from sign-up to first text — no surprises, go live faster.

blocks.note: typical timeline for a new organization

paragraphs.text: Because U.S. and Canadian carriers regulate business texting to stop spam, every business must be registered and approved before a single message can send. This guide walks you through all five stages, what your team needs to do, and how to move as fast as possible.
Your Onboarding Manager prepares and submits the carrier registration for you. Depending on your plan, a dedicated Customer Success Manager supports you through to go-live.

blocks.heading: Stage 1 — Welcome & kickoff · Day 0–3
blocks.intro: You sign up and are matched with an Onboarding Manager for a kickoff call to set your goals and plan.

rows.definition: Share your use case, user count, phone numbers, integrations and target go-live date.
Kickoff complete; onboarding plan and recap delivered.

blocks.title: Carriers decide approval, not Salesmsg
blocks.text: You can't send texts until your business is registered and approved by the carriers (10DLC or Toll-Free). Approval takes several business days — sometimes longer. Brand-new EINs can take 30–90 days to become verifiable.

pages.title: Compliance and
pages.subtitle: The gate you must clear, and the configuration we run in parallel.

blocks.heading: Stage 2 — Compliance & registration · The gate
blocks.intro: We register your business with the carriers: 10DLC for local numbers, or Toll-Free Verification for toll-free and Canadian numbers. We manage the entire carrier review.

rows.definition: Must exactly match your IRS records.
Active site with Privacy Policy (including SMS consent language) and Terms.
Web form, paper form, text-to-join keyword, or QR code.
Clear description of what you'll text plus a couple of real example messages.
Brand and Campaign approved by carriers; sending unlocked on your account.

blocks.heading: Stage 3 — Account setup · In parallel
blocks.intro: We configure your account while compliance runs — confirm your users, numbers and integrations.

rows.definition: Get new local numbers, or transfer, port or host your existing numbers.
Added and mapped to inboxes with assignment rules and business hours.
Connect your CRM (e.g. HubSpot) and tools like Aircall or RingCentral.
Numbers, users and integrations are live; test message sends successfully.

blocks.title: Accurate info is your fastest path
blocks.text: The single biggest way to go live faster is to get us your business details early and accurate. If anything is rejected, we tell you exactly what to fix and resubmit for you.

blocks.heading: Stage 4 — Training · Before launch
blocks.intro: We train your team so adoption sticks — a 1:1 admin session and a group session for your users.

rows.definition: 1:1 session covering setup, workflows and your CRM integration.
Group session: 1:1 texting, broadcasts, tags, contacts and calling.
Weekly live webinar series and Help Center, any time you need them.
Admins and users trained; recap resources and recording delivered.

blocks.heading: Stage 5 — Go-live & ongoing support · ~Day 20+
blocks.intro: You launch. We check in on go-live morning, then follow up two weeks later to confirm your KPIs.

rows.definition: We check in the morning to confirm everyone is set.
Follow-up to clear blockers and confirm the KPIs you're measuring.
Live, measured, on a regular cadence with your Customer Success team.

blocks.title: Not sure where you stand?
blocks.text: Your Onboarding Manager and Customer Success Manager can tell you exactly which stage you're in and what's outstanding — ask any time.

items.question: Why can't we just start texting right away?
items.answer: U.S. and Canadian carriers require registration (10DLC or Toll-Free) to fight spam. Until approved, carriers block business texts.

items.question: How long does compliance take?
items.answer: Often several business days once submitted — sometimes longer if carriers request changes or your EIN is newly issued.

items.question: We're in Canada — is anything different?
items.answer: Yes. Canadian numbers must use Toll-Free Verification; 10DLC isn't available in Canada. We'll guide you through it.

items.question: Can we keep our existing phone numbers?
items.answer: In most cases, yes. Numbers can be transferred, ported, or hosted during Account Setup — just let us know.
